# Support

Zephyreader's source is mirrored publicly at
[github.com/JamesonRGrieve/Zephyreader](https://github.com/JamesonRGrieve/Zephyreader).

- **Bugs and questions about the code:** search the
  [existing issues](https://github.com/JamesonRGrieve/Zephyreader/issues), then open a
  [new issue](https://github.com/JamesonRGrieve/Zephyreader/issues/new) if yours isn't there.
- **Privacy and your data** (a copy of what's stored, a deletion, a question about the privacy
  policy): email [privacy@zephyrex.ca](mailto:privacy@zephyrex.ca), never an issue. Issues are
  public, so don't post an email address or anything else personal in one.
- **Security problems:** see [SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md) and report them privately.

The project is maintained by one person, so replies may take a few days.
